A '''radiation sensor''', also known as a '''radiation counter'''<ref name="SWS2">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> or a '''Geiger counter'''<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that measured [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. It could be installed into a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] chassis.<ref name="RPG" /> The [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] was fitted with radiation sensors as part of its [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
